commands.text: 看到了吗？魔族占领了坎特伯雷王国！
据说…是王国做了坏事，所以受到了攻击。
呃…那个，那些家伙特别有钱，但是…总不听姐姐的话。
你早上也没听大姐的话呀。为什么魔族不抓你啊？

talk.en_us: See that? Demons have seized the Kanterbury Kingdom.
They say the kingdom was attacked becuse they behaved badly.
Uh.. well you know. They were filthy rich and didn't listen to their big sis.
You didn't listen to big sis this morning. Why didn't demons get you?
You just listen to me and big sis. Any question against me is naughty behavior.
